heading: Why work with me
lede: Four things that tend to matter more than a portfolio does.

reasons.title: I design for the checkout, not the screenshot
reasons.body: Every decision gets judged on whether it helps someone finish, not on how it photographs in a case study. Some of the best work I have done looks like nothing at all.

reasons.title: Developers can actually build it
reasons.body: States, edge cases, empty views, and error copy arrive with the design — not after the first review.

reasons.title: I work inside your constraints
reasons.body: Existing theme, existing stack, existing team. A redesign that requires replacing all three is a proposal, not a plan.

reasons.title: You will know what changed and why
reasons.body: Each delivery comes with the reasoning written down, so the decisions survive after I am gone and nobody has to guess what a screen was for.
